* '''Playtest''' ([[Takodana: Maz's Castle (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-takodanamazscastle-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/takodanamazscastle.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Once per turn, may ▼ a Maz's Castle site.” Dark Side: “If you control, opponent must use 1 Force to use their Takodana: Maz's Castle game text.”
* '''Original''' ([[Takodana: Maz's Castle]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-takodanamazscastle-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d24ffc3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/takodanamazscastle.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Once per turn, may ▼ a Maz's Castle site.” Dark Side: “If you control, opponent must use 1 Force to use their Takodana: Maz's Castle game text.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics, and the line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” was added; the image is now stored as a landscape site card (it was stored upright on 1 August); same words.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-L-takodanamazscastle.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/hires/takodanamazscastle.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Once per turn, may ▼ a Maz's Castle site.” Dark Side: “If you control, opponent must use 1 Force to use their Takodana: Maz's Castle game text.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same words; re-rendered at high resolution (the credit line now reads “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”).
*: [[File:V11-L-takodanamazscastle-20230329-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
